findings.title: Refresh Cookie SameSite='lax' in OAuth Callback vs 'strict' Elsewhere
findings.summary: The cws_refresh cookie is set with SameSite: 'lax' in the OAuth callback route but SameSite: 'strict' in the refresh route and setAuthCookies().
findings.attackScenario: After an OAuth login, an attacker crafts a cross-site form POST to /api/auth/refresh. With SameSite: 'lax', the browser sends the refresh cookie.
findings.rootCause: The OAuth callback route manually sets cookies instead of using the shared setAuthCookies() function
findings.remediation: Change sameSite: 'lax' to sameSite: 'strict' on line 152. Or refactor to use setAuthCookies().

findings.title: TOTP Re-enrollment Does Not Require Sudo Mode
findings.summary: verifyAndEnableTotpAction calls requireActiveSession() but not requireSudoMode(). An attacker with a valid session could replace the victim's TOTP secret.
findings.attackScenario: Attacker obtains a valid session cookie and replaces victim's TOTP with their own authenticator.
findings.rootCause: verifyAndEnableTotpAction uses requireActiveSession() instead of requireSudoMode()
findings.remediation: Add requireSudoMode() check when TOTP is already enabled (re-enrollment).

findings.title: No Rate Limiting on Session Refresh Endpoint
findings.summary: The refresh endpoint has no per-IP or per-token rate limit. An attacker with a valid refresh token could flood the endpoint.
findings.attackScenario: Attacker floods POST /api/auth/refresh at high frequency, exhausting MongoDB connection pool.
findings.rootCause: Refresh endpoint relies on origin-check and token rotation but has no explicit request throttle
findings.remediation: Add per-IP rate limit (e.g., 60 requests/min) using existing LoginAttemptRepository pattern.

findings.title: TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY Boot Guard Not Verified
findings.summary: The TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY is required in production but the boot guard was not explicitly verified during this audit.
findings.attackScenario: Production runs without TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY or with a weak key. Attacker with DB access decrypts all TOTP secrets.
findings.rootCause: Boot guard may not enforce minimum length or complexity for the key
findings.remediation: Add explicit fail-closed boot guard: require minimum 32 characters, refuse to boot if missing in production.

findings.title: Dev-Mode Mailer Logs 2FA Codes and Reset Links to stdout
findings.summary: When email env vars are not configured, the dev fallback logs full email content to console.info.
findings.attackScenario: Production misconfigured without email config. All 2FA codes and reset links logged to stdout.
findings.rootCause: Dev fallback lacks a NODE_ENV === 'production' guard
findings.remediation: Add production guard: if NODE_ENV === 'production' and no email configured, throw error instead of logging.

findings.title: Debug Filesystem Writes in verify-2fa.ts
findings.summary: fs.appendFileSync writes device IDs and trust state to debug-verify.log.
findings.attackScenario: In shared hosting/containerized environment, debug log file persists on disk.
findings.remediation: Remove fs.appendFileSync calls or gate behind a DEBUG environment variable.

findings.title: OAuth State Comparison Uses !== Instead of timingSafeEqual
findings.summary: OAuth state comparison uses !== instead of crypto.timingSafeEqual().
findings.rootCause: Standard JavaScript comparison used instead of timing-safe
findings.remediation: Replace with crypto.timingSafeEqual(Buffer.from(state), Buffer.from(expectedState))

findings.title: No Per-IP Rate Limit on Password Reset Request
findings.summary: Reset request records IP but does not call checkIpRateLimit().
findings.rootCause: Per-IP check not added to reset request path
findings.remediation: Add checkIpRateLimit(ipAddress) at start of requestReset()

findings.title: HSTS Header at Edge Not Verified
findings.summary: HSTS header is not set in application code and must be configured at the edge/CDN level.
findings.rootCause: Application defers HTTPS enforcement to hosting platform
findings.remediation: 1. Verify hosting platform configures HSTS. 2. Add header in next.config.ts as defense-in-depth.

findings.title: HTTPS Enforcement at Edge Not Verified
findings.summary: HTTP-to-HTTPS redirect must be configured at the edge.
findings.rootCause: Application relies on platform for HTTPS enforcement
findings.remediation: 1. Document required edge configuration. 2. Add E2E test.

findings.title: Production Database Backup Strategy Not Verified
findings.summary: No backup configuration found in application code.
findings.rootCause: Backup strategy is infrastructure concern outside application boundary
findings.remediation: 1. Document required backup strategy. 2. Verify MongoDB Atlas backup config.

findings.title: Production Logging Infrastructure Not Verified
findings.summary: Application uses console.error and audit_logs collection but no external logging infrastructure configured.
findings.rootCause: Logging infrastructure is external to application code
findings.remediation: 1. Document required logging infrastructure. 2. Verify audit logs are exported.

findings.title: Production Monitoring and Alerting Not Verified
findings.summary: In-app alerting exists but external monitoring not configured in code.
findings.remediation: 1. Document monitoring stack. 2. Verify alerting thresholds.

findings.title: CI/CD Secret Protection Not Verified
findings.summary: No CI/CD configuration found in repository.
findings.rootCause: CI/CD is external to application code
findings.remediation: 1. Document CI/CD secret management. 2. Verify secrets not logged.

findings.title: Preview Environment Isolation Not Verified
findings.summary: Preview environments may share databases, secrets, or network access with production.
findings.remediation: 1. Document isolation strategy. 2. Verify separate databases.

findings.title: No CAPTCHA on Login
findings.summary: Login relies on IP+identifier rate limiting without CAPTCHA.
findings.evidence: No CAPTCHA mechanism in login flow
findings.remediation: Consider CAPTCHA after N failed attempts as defense-in-depth

findings.title: Reset Token Passed in URL Query Parameter
findings.summary: Reset token in URL query parameter may appear in browser history, server logs, proxy logs.
findings.rootCause: Common pattern for email-based reset links
findings.remediation: Consider using fragment or POST-based flow

findings.title: No Email Notification on Account Lockout
findings.summary: When account is locked due to 5 failed attempts, no email notification is sent.
findings.rootCause: No notification mechanism for lockout events
findings.remediation: Consider sending email on lockout

findings.title: No Timeout on JWKS Fetch
findings.summary: JWKS fetch has no timeout/abort controller.
findings.remediation: Add 5-10 second timeout using AbortController

findings.title: IPv6 Address Normalization Not Verified
findings.summary: getClientIp() returns raw header value without IPv6 normalization.
findings.remediation: Normalize IPv6 addresses

findings.title: Recovery Code Failures Share 2FA Failure Window
findings.summary: Recovery code and email 2FA code failures share the same 5-per-15-minute counter.
findings.rootCause: Shared failure counter for all 2FA methods
findings.remediation: Consider separate per-user counter for recovery code failures

findings.title: Password Reset Allows Repeated Daily Cycles
findings.summary: Rate limits use sliding 15-minute window with no daily cap.
findings.rootCause: No longer-term daily cap on reset requests
findings.remediation: Add daily cap (e.g., 15 per 24 hours) per email

findings.title: Serverless Race Condition on Rate-Limit Counters
findings.summary: Rate-limit check uses read-then-write pattern, not atomic.
findings.remediation: Accept known limitation for current scale; document tolerance.

findings.title: Login Failure Spike Alerting Uses In-Memory Aggregation
findings.summary: Spike detection uses in-memory Map not shared across serverless instances.
findings.rootCause: In-memory aggregation not shared across processes
findings.remediation: Move spike detection to MongoDB or increase threshold

findings.title: No Global IP Lockout Across Accounts
findings.summary: Lockout is per-user. Attacker rotating through email list from same IP gets separate per-email counters.
findings.remediation: Consider more aggressive per-IP limit

findings.title: Missing Permissions-Policy Directives for Modern Browser Features
findings.summary: Only camera, microphone, geolocation restricted. Other powerful features allowed by default.
findings.remediation: Extend to comprehensive deny list

findings.title: No Verified Rate Limiting on WebAuthn Endpoints
findings.summary: WebAuthn endpoints lack explicit IP-based rate limiting.
findings.remediation: Add per-IP rate limit on login-options endpoint

findings.title: CSP style-src Allows unsafe-inline
findings.summary: style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline' required by React/Next.js for runtime inline styles.
findings.remediation: Accept as framework requirement; ensure script-src does NOT include unsafe-inline

findings.title: CORS Configuration for Mobile API — Fail-Open Not Verified
findings.summary: MOBILE_ALLOWED_ORIGINS defaults to empty array. Need to verify CORS middleware rejects cross-origin when empty.
findings.remediation: Verify CORS middleware rejects when allowedOrigins is empty

findings.title: Pepper Not Enforced as Mandatory in Schema
findings.summary: ARGON2_SECRET optional in Zod schema, relying on validateSecurityConfig() to enforce in production.
findings.remediation: Accept as-is; production fail-closed guard is effective

findings.title: Argon2id Parameters Could Be Stronger
findings.summary: Current parameters (64MB, t=3, p=1) are acceptable for internal admin tool but below OWASP recommended 128MB.
findings.rootCause: Parameters tuned for internal tool use case
findings.remediation: Consider increasing memoryCost to 128MB

findings.title: No Password Expiration
findings.summary: Passwords do not expire. Consistent with NIST SP 800-63B. May conflict with PCI DSS.
findings.remediation: Document as intentional design decision

findings.title: No Character Class Complexity Requirements
findings.summary: No complexity requirements. NIST-aligned; zxcvbn catches weak passwords.
findings.remediation: Document as intentional design decision

findings.title: Progressive Delay Maximum Cap
findings.summary: Progressive delay grows exponentially without explicit cap.
findings.remediation: Consider adding explicit maximum cap

findings.title: No Explicit Cleanup for Abandoned TOTP Enrollments
findings.summary: Abandoned TOTP enrollments (secret stored but not verified) are not cleaned up.
findings.remediation: Add cleanup for unverified TOTP secrets

findings.title: TOTP Secrets Stored in Plaintext When Encryption Key Missing
findings.summary: When TOTP_ENCRYPTION_KEY not set, secrets stored in plaintext. Gated to dev environments only.
findings.rootCause: Dev fallback for missing encryption key
findings.remediation: Accept as dev-only; production requires encryption key

findings.title: X-Content-Type-Options at Edge Not Verified
findings.summary: Header set in application but edge may not preserve it.
findings.remediation: Verify edge preserves header

findings.title: Referrer-Policy at Edge Not Verified
findings.summary: Referrer-Policy set in application but edge may not preserve.
findings.remediation: Verify edge preserves header

findings.title: Permissions-Policy at Edge Not Verified
findings.summary: Permissions-Policy set in application but edge may not preserve.
findings.remediation: Verify edge preserves header

findings.title: Cache Controls Not Verified for All Dashboard Routes
findings.summary: QR code route sets Cache-Control: no-store. Other routes may need explicit cache headers.
findings.remediation: Add Cache-Control: no-store to authenticated routes

findings.title: Email Delivery Failure Does Not Block Authentication
findings.summary: Email send failures are logged but never thrown. User without email delivery has no 2FA path except recovery codes.
findings.rootCause: Deliberate design; recovery codes provide fallback
findings.remediation: Accept as intentional design decision
